about: Where a match island may be (creator: no oceans, lakes, snow, bamboo or giant mountains; rivers are fine; a new island every match). Changing this sheet makes the world pick a new island. Island centres are searched until no sampled point inside the first circle is in an excluded biome. Lava lakes, caves and ravines are switched off in world generation (data pack in the mod); world-generation changes apply to new land only, so a new island is always placed on land never generated before. Rivers are allowed.
